lines.en: Oh, I'm so glad someone's here.
Can you believe no one between my apartment and here
offered to do that for me?
So, uh, why are you so dressed up?
Oh, um, Mike's picking me up for a date.
I mean, you know, I like him.
But, you know, am I ready to take my grade-A loins
You know, I really admire your whole dating attitude.
I'm always like, is this moving too fast?
Yeah, you know, you are a bit of a drama queen.
Well, you, you're so much better off, you know?
You just go from guy to guy, having fun,
and not worrying that it never turns into anything serious.
Okay, well, there's got to be someone.
I know, and yet here you are, all ready for the next day.
I can't believe I never realized this before.
I'm in my 30s, and I've never been in a long-term relationship.
Oh, my God, what's wrong with me?
I mean, you don't strike me as the type of person
that wants to get married anyway.
Please, please don't cry because of me.
I, I don't know what I'm talking about, okay?
Well, at least you've been married.
Oh, my God, I want to trade lives with Ross?
